title: build(deps): bump postcss from 8.5.26 to 8.5.28
intent: Routine Dependabot currency, no advisory. postcss 8.5.26 -> 8.5.28 in packages/client (devDependency). Patch-level. Build-time CSS pipeline only. Authored by hand because Dependabot cannot author a manifest (CBSP21-NOBORROW-001); the payload of that friction is the lockfile audit in behavior_change.
behavior_change: none. Lockfile audited against rebase base df39c4f3 (origin/main) by parsing both package-lock.json trees and comparing every `packages` entry, not by reading the diff view. Entry count is 412 before and 412 after. Exactly 1 entry changed version: postcss 8.5.26 -> 8.5.28. Zero packages added, zero removed, and no entry outside postcss touched. The root packages entry differs in exactly one field, devDependencies.postcss ^8.5.26 -> ^8.5.28. This is the check PR #296 failed -- a bump whose title named one package while the lockfile moved another -- so it was run as an enumeration rather than an eyeball. The audit was re-derived after the rebase rather than carried over from the pre-rebase base d59de10f, because a rebase changes the base the claim is about.

diff_articulation.what_changed: packages/client/package.json moves the single declared range for postcss from ^8.5.26 to ^8.5.28 -- one line, no other dependency touched. package-lock.json resolves it: postcss 8.5.26 -> 8.5.28. No incidental version movement; the added, removed and non-postcss changed sets are all empty. Reader note: the diff also shows nanoid moving ^3.3.17 -> ^3.3.18, which is NOT a dependency bump -- it is the declared range inside postcss's own metadata block. The installed node_modules/nanoid entry is 3.3.18 at the base and 3.3.18 at the head, unchanged. This line has already been misread once as an incidental package bump; enumeration, not the diff view, is what distinguishes them.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Dependabot currency, stated plainly. No existing manifest covers this diff, and several manifests written for other dependency work would each have covered these two files -- borrowing one is what CBSP21-NOBORROW-001 refuses.

commands_run: lockfile audit (enumeration, not diff-reading) vs rebase base df39c4f3: entries 412 -> 412, version-changed=1 (postcss 8.5.26 -> 8.5.28), added=0, removed=0, non-postcss touched = NONE

rebase conflict resolution verified non-reverting: the branch conflicted because four sibling bumps (happy-dom, @supabase/supabase-js, zod, @types/node) landed on main after the original base, and happy-dom sits on the line directly above postcss in both files. Resolution keeps both sides; @supabase/supabase-js ^2.115.0, zod ^4.5.4, @types/node ^26.4.1 and happy-dom ^20.14.0 all confirmed still present at head
CI is the only build/test verification for this bump
